title: No Aims
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: Nomon Tim Burnett rehearses the opening teaching for Samish Sesshin by taking up Book of Serenity case 49, where Dongshan is asked what his teacher Yunyan meant by "just this is it," alongside Thich Nhat Hanh's three doors of liberation. Nomon begins with the image of a pilgrim walking a path, then asks what it means when meditation turns out scattered, numb, or painful. Emptiness arrives through Thich Nhat Hanh's wind with no blower, signlessness through a swallow too rich for the word "swallow," and aimlessness through the raft that gets put down. In the Q&A, Nomon places this Mahayana list, the vimoksha mukha, against the early three marks of reality.
